text:
A look at “Drawn to Wonderland,” an indoor playground inspired by Alice in Wonderland 🫖 #DisneyWorld
The Magic of Disney Animation opens September 14 at Disney’s Hollywood Studios ✨

“Drawn to Wonderland” is for the enjoyment of children ages 6 months - 5 years old. From the playful chaos of the Mad Tea Party and Mad Hatter’s house to the Queen of Hearts’ vibrant rose garden and the Cheshire Cat’s mysterious Tulgey Wood, young guests will love climbing, wandering, and creating their own adventure around every corner of this new playground.
